name: Somchai Srisawat
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but amidst the intricate weaves of traditional Thai silk. His family ran a small weaving business, instilling in him a deep appreciation for material properties and meticulous craftsmanship. He transitioned these skills to composite materials after discovering a passion for motorsports, taking night classes while working at the family business. He excelled, quickly mastering the art of carbon fiber layup and resin infusion. 

At Sodi Kart Factory, Somchai is known for his unwavering commitment to perfection. He meticulously inspects every piece he works on, ensuring it meets the highest standards of structural integrity and aerodynamic efficiency. His ambition extends beyond mere competence; he actively seeks out innovative solutions to improve kart performance, often experimenting with new materials and techniques during his own time. He is respected for his attention to detail, which consistently leads to improved kart performance and reliability.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave in the front.
physical.description: Somchai has a focused gaze and a lean build, suggesting dedication and precision.

quirks: Always carries a small magnifying glass to inspect composite surfaces.
Has a habit of humming traditional Thai folk songs while working, especially when stressed.
Insists on using only a specific brand of Japanese-made carbon fiber.
